title: Rooms on One Map
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about many rooms on one map. A map is much bigger than the screen, so four rooms in four corners of it can be four scenes that load the same map file, each landing the hero in a different cell with scrolling off. A door is a link that can land in any cell, even one that is not next door. Signs in the rooms say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and move where a door lands.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie walks through a red room, a blue room, a green room and a gold room that are really four corners of one big map. A door drops her into another cell, and it need not be next door. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and move where a door lands.
features: Signs in the rooms explain each idea
Rooms are cells of one map, and a door lands in another cell
Made to be copied and taken apart
